name: Vitals
author: Vitals contributors
description: Live CPU, memory, GPU, storage and I/O vitals with per-core meters, a one-minute history, and the processes behind the numbers.

barWidget.description: System vitals at a glance: load, memory, thermals, I/O, and top processes, all in the shell's own theme.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: Sampling cadence while the panel is closed. The panel samples every second while open.

schema.label: Show CPU % in the bar
schema.description: Right-click the bar icon to toggle.

schema.label: Expand CPU cores by default
schema.description: Show per-core meters on open without clicking to expand.

schema.label: Elevated threshold (%)
schema.description: CPU or memory at or above this shows in the accent color.

schema.label: Critical threshold (%)
schema.description: CPU or memory at or above this shows in the urgent color and lights the bar icon.
